operator.identity: Candidate C one-sided smoothstep blend of raw and sign-corrected mu0, composed with the existing GridSDF normal-floor body and normal_floor=0.25
operator.mu1: WaterLily mu1(d_face,epsilon) times the wrapped body's normal; unchanged by Candidate C

flow.profile_reference: v16 finite-box native WaterLily profile settings
flow.force_sampling: every solver step after the target window begins
flow.force_conversion_to_newtons: multiply WaterLily body-force components by 1/900 N per solver-force unit

canonical_grid_sdf.sampling: evaluate each analytic SDF at every registered canonical grid node

fixtures.control: native WaterLily AutoBody with the exact analytic sphere SDF

fixtures.analytic_sdf: exact axis-aligned box SDF centered at (0,0,-0.2)m with half extents (0.25,0.025,0.25)m
fixtures.control: native WaterLily AutoBody with the exact analytic box SDF

fixtures.analytic_sdf: exact axis-aligned box SDF centered at (0,0,-0.2)m with half extents (0.25,0.05,0.25)m
fixtures.control: native WaterLily AutoBody with the exact analytic box SDF

fixtures.analytic_sdf: no design body; registered moving ground only
fixtures.control: WaterLily NoBody union the registered moving ground

arms.native_control: analytic AutoBody (or NoBody for ground-only) unioned with the same moving ground
arms.candidate: sampled GridSDF through NormalFloorWaterLilyBody(normal_floor=0.25), CandidateCWaterLilyBody wrapper, and the same moving ground

recorded_metrics: steps, achieved tU/L, and number of sampled steps
pressure, viscous and total force vectors in N, with per-sample max closure error in N
finite velocity and pressure field indicators
inlet and outlet x-velocity plane sums and their difference in solver units (diagnostic flux proxy, not kg/s)
SHA-256 of each generated Float32 phi array

decision_rules.interpretation: report raw paired diagnostics only; do not claim solver equivalence, conservation qualification, physical accuracy, W3-C/W4-C passage, or production acceptance
stop_on: any non-finite pressure or velocity field
failure of the registered GridSDF margin constructor
force component closure error above 1e-12 N
source, plan, or input identity mismatch

output: unique work/candidate_c_fixture_diagnostic_2026_10/<run-id>.csv; create exclusively and retain raw output
execution_gate: parent review of CandidateCWaterLilyBody.jl, this plan, and the runner is required before the first sim_step! fixture run
explicit_non_goals: FD, gradient, reverse, optimizer, topology, or shape-update qualification
individual force attribution to the exceptional FD-07 face
